hints.title: Tracking Active Head Nodes
hints.text: At any point during merging, only the current smallest head node among all lists needs to be appended next.

hints.title: Maintaining Minimum Node Candidates
hints.text: Store the current head of each non-empty list in a priority-ordered structure. Extract the minimum and advance its pointer.

hints.title: Priority Queue Multi-List Merging
hints.text: Insert initial list heads into a min collection ordered by node value. Repeatedly extract the node with minimum value, append it to the merged chain, and if that node has a subsequent element, insert its successor into the collection.

complexity.notes: Optimal min-heap merging maintaining at most K candidates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all K list heads linearly at every step yields O(N * K) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Min-heap of size K yields logarithmic node insertion and retrieval.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use index tie-breakers in Python tuple heaps to avoid comparing ListNode instances directly.
